findings.claim: Medtronic 的 Hugo 手術機器人於 2025 年 12 月取得 FDA 泌尿科適應症許可，可在美國醫院廣泛行銷。
findings.source: eWeek｜Medtronic's 'Hugo' Surgical Robot Receives FDA Clearance for Urological Procedures
findings.excerpt: Medtronic can now widely market its Hugo robotic-assisted surgery system to American hospitals.

findings.claim: J&J Ottava 據稱於 2026 年中獲 FDA 許可十項一般外科術式；Intuitive 2026 年股價大幅回檔（來源為股票分析文章）。
findings.source: TIKR｜Intuitive Surgical fell 30% in 2026 as a rival arrived
findings.excerpt: Six days later, the FDA cleared Johnson & Johnson’s Ottava robot for ten general-surgery procedures, the first credible challenger in soft-tissue surgery, da Vinci’s core turf, in two decades.

findings.claim: Intuitive 因競爭與中國標案偏好本土廠商，成長放緩。
findings.source: Bloomberg｜Intuitive Surgical Falls as Rivalry, Funding Slows Growth

findings.claim: Medtronic 已提交 Hugo 一般外科與婦科 510(k)；2026-02-17 Cleveland Clinic 完成美國首例商業 Hugo 手術。
findings.source: MedTech Dive｜Medtronic completes first Hugo case in the US
findings.excerpt: procedure for its Hugo robotic surgery system, shortly after the company received Food and Drug Administration clearance for the platform. The first surgery was a prostatectomy procedure performed at the Cleveland Clinic.

findings.claim: 第三方再製 Intuitive 器械與 Restore Robotics 反壟斷訴訟威脅高毛利器械與配件業務；Deutsche Bank 2025 年 6 月因此降評。
findings.source: Motley Fool｜Why Intuitive Surgical stock plunged today
